_meta.purpose: No-hook loop evidence: the elaborate destination carries no panel lane and therefore no progress hook — every re-entry counts and the guard halts at re-entry 3 with max 2. The halt row keeps the older message form (3 backward jumps (max 2)) — the no-panel marker, contrasting the panel fixtures re-entered N times wording.
_meta.excerpt_rule: Minimal: only the routing rows into `elaborate` (the first is the first visit; the rest are re-entries) and the halt row. Every other row dropped — the no-hook guard path consumes no channel state.
_meta.channel_rule: Routing-only excerpt — no stage rows, no channels.
_meta.trim_rule: Routing rows keep type/fromStage/decision verbatim; the halt row is normalized to the new kind {type:halt,stage,errMsg} with errMsg verbatim.
_meta.row_format: compact one-row-per-line JSON (each rows[] element on a single line)
